outcomes.description: Move the book behind the flower, including the requested relative depth ordering.

nodes.question: Compared with the source, is the book behind the flower, or is there clear evidence it has been moved toward that behind-the-flower depth ordering?
nodes.criteria: complete: the book is visibly behind the flower in the edited image. partial: the book is not yet behind the flower, but comparison with the source clearly shows it was moved toward the flower in a way that advances the requested relative depth ordering. Do not count mere proximity, displacement without evidence it advances the depth ordering, or unrelated changes to the book or flower. absent: the book is not behind the flower and there is no visible progress toward that depth ordering. unknown: the source-to-edit comparison cannot establish whether the book was moved toward the requested depth ordering.
nodes.binding: Target: the book; reference: the flower; requested relation: book behind flower, assessed by relative depth ordering and comparison with the source.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
